hero.sub:
Social media, work pressure, daily struggles — your brain is quietly absorbing stress you can't even name. TheraNode helps you track how you actually feel, spot hidden patterns, and break negative spirals before they take root.
No cloud or online accounts. Just you and your truth.
why.label: The Modern Mind
why.desc: In a world that never stops talking, understanding yourself starts with a single honest moment each day.
why.card1.title: The Overload
why.card1.desc: In the last two decades, the volume of information hitting your brain has exploded — social media, news cycles, work pressure, family demands. Your mind wasn't built to process all of this at once. Silently, stress accumulates and misconceptions slip through unfiltered.
why.card2.title: The Silent Spiral
why.card2.desc: You notice something feels off — a heaviness, irritability, exhaustion you can't explain. But life keeps moving. You push it aside. Days pass. The feeling grows quietly until you feel broken and can't even remember when or why it started.
why.card3.title: The Anchor
why.card3.desc:
What if you could press pause every day and ask: "How do I actually feel right now?"

TheraNode captures that very moment - your node. Week by week, it builds a living map of your mental landscape. By tagging entries with context like #Work or #Family, TheraNode reveals the correlations between your life events and your emotional state — helping you connect the dots.
features.label: Core Features
features.desc: Everything you need to understand your mind, built with privacy as the foundation.
features.card1.title: Zero Account Setup
features.card1.desc: Skip the sign-up. Start logging in 10 seconds without providing an email, phone number, or password. 100% on your device.
features.card2.title: 23 Precision Indicators
features.card2.desc: Go beyond basic emojis. Log Mood, Stress, Energy, Sleep, and 19 more behavioral signals to spot hidden correlations.
features.card3.title: Therapist-Ready PDF Export
features.card3.desc: Generate professional weekly reports with long-term trend data. Designed specifically to bring into your therapy sessions.
tree.desc: TheraNode is designed for simplicity and ease of mind at the user interface level, while its powerful architecture works silently in the background — processing 23 behavioral indicators, analyzing behavioral patterns and correlations, and generating professional-grade insights from your honest daily check-ins.
how.label: The Workflow
how.desc: A simple, repeatable process to take back control of your mental well-being.
how.step1.title: Press Pause
how.step1.desc: Once a day, step away from the noise. Open TheraNode and use the simple sliders to log your current state. No typing required unless you want to add context.
how.step2.title: Build Momentum
how.step2.desc: Consistency is key. By logging daily, you create a chain of 'nodes'. Each node is a truthful snapshot of your mind at that specific moment.
how.step3.title: Watch the Map Emerge
how.step3.desc: As the days pass, TheraNode's engine connects the dots. Beautiful, private charts reveal the hidden rhythms of your mood, stress, and energy.
how.step4.title: Take Meaningful Action
how.step4.desc: Armed with real data, you can finally see what drains you and what heals you. Adjust your habits, or optionally export a PDF report to share with your therapist.

priv.desc: We believe your mental health data is the most sensitive information you own. That's why TheraNode operates fundamentally differently from other wellness apps.
priv.card1.title: No Internet Required
priv.card1.desc: The app functions perfectly offline. Your data never transmits anywhere.
priv.card2.title: No Online Accounts
priv.card2.desc: Skip the sign-up. There is no central database linking you to your logs.
priv.card3.title: No Analytics
priv.card3.desc: We don't use third-party trackers to monitor how you use the app.
safety.badge1: No data shared with third parties
safety.badge2: No data collected on the cloud
safety.label: Crisis Support
safety.desc: When TheraNode detects elevated distress indicators, it proactively displays a Safety Nudge — offering direct access to your therapist's phone number and your country's crisis helpline.
safety.feat1.title: 45+ Countries Supported
safety.feat1.desc: Verified crisis hotlines across North America, Europe, Asia, Latin America, Oceania, and Africa.
safety.feat2.title: Connectivity-Aware
safety.feat2.desc: The app checks for an active SIM card and cellular service before offering call buttons. If unavailable, numbers are displayed as copyable text.
safety.feat3.title: Not a Diagnosis
safety.feat3.desc: TheraNode does not diagnose. It simply observes self-reported markers and connects you to support when thresholds are exceeded.

faq.label: About TheraNode
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about how TheraNode works. For full technical details, check the support section inside the app.
faq.q1: Do I need to be in therapy to use TheraNode?
faq.a1: Not at all. While TheraNode generates professional-grade reports that therapists love, it is primarily designed for your own self-reflection. It helps you understand your own mind, whether you share that data with a professional or keep it entirely to yourself.
faq.q2: If there are no accounts, what happens if I lose my phone?
faq.a2: Because TheraNode stores everything locally to protect your privacy, data is not automatically synced to the cloud. You must use the built-in Encrypted Backup feature to save a backup file to your own Google Drive, iCloud, or PC.
faq.q3: Can you reset my PIN if I forget it?
faq.a3: No. We have no servers and no backdoors. If you forget your PIN, your only option is to answer the Security Question you set up during onboarding. If you forget both, you will need to reinstall the app and start over.
faq.q4: How does the Emergency button work?
faq.a4: If the app detects a pattern of severe distress, it will gently offer a lifeline. Tapping the emergency button simply opens your phone's native dialer with a crisis hotline or your therapist's number pre-filled. It does not place the call automatically, nor does it record that the button was pressed.
faq.q5: Is TheraNode free? Will I hit a paywall immediately?
faq.a5: TheraNode offers a generous Free forever tier that includes all daily tracking, basic charts, and journaling without limits. We also offer an optional 'Pro' upgrade which unlocks the Therapist-Ready PDF Export and 15 Advanced Indicators. We believe basic mental health tracking should be accessible to everyone.
cta.h2: Your Mind Deserves a Safe Space
cta.desc: No sign-up required. Your data never leaves your device. Begin tracking your emotional clarity in under 30 seconds.

testi.label: Testimonials
testi.desc: See how TheraNode is helping individuals and professionals.
testi.q1: TheraNode is the first tracker that actually helps me understand why I feel the way I do. It's not just logging emojis; the weekly correlation charts showed me exactly how my sleep directly impacted my afternoon stress.
testi.q2: I recommend TheraNode to all my clients. The professional PDF export brings concrete data into our sessions. Instead of spending 20 minutes trying to recall feelings, we look at the radar chart and get right to the work.
testi.q3: The zero-account setup is exactly what I was looking for. I am exhausted by apps that demand my email and force cloud syncing. TheraNode being 100% offline-first makes it the only wellness app I trust.
